preconditions.description: The length of s1 is at least 1 and at most 5000.
The length of s2 is at least 1 and at most 5000.
Each string in s1 has a length between 5 and 25.
Each string in s2 has a length between 5 and 25.

postconditions.expression: output == count_if(any(is_prefix(s1, s2[i]) or is_suffix(s1, s2[i]) for i in range(len(s2))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of strings in s2 that are either a prefix or suffix of at least one string in s1.
